changed.unlocks: settles this statement on the record; whichever side is proved is kept
changed.context: Truth unknown; our support is small cases only. A circuit with NOT gates right on the promise is turned into one without, paying at most 2n - 5 more gates. The exclusive-OR graph shows the slope cannot be lower: 4 gates with NOT against exactly 2n - 1 without, a gap of 2n - 5. At side 3 the bound is 1 above; a 3 by 3 graph costing 6 with NOT gates and 8 or more without would break it. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
changed.sketch: Merge duplicate lines. Restriction costs no gates. Restoring a line costs at most one OR. In the reduced r by c table, two unread lines in a bank would match. At least r+c-2 raw wires reach the output, requiring r+c-3 binary gates. At that budget the source is positive. One gate higher, a live NOT forces a tree with one use per wire and one omitted line per bank. On mask 14303 only full lines can be omitted. Derive a terminal NOT by polarity: a six-gate source would give a five-gate complement, below its checked minimum of six. Then tackle larger budgets.

changed.title: Find a fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit under the ranked cyclic witness negation bound
changed.statement:
∃ (n w : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (q : Fin (2 ^ n)),
  let I := n * 2 ^ (w + 1)
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (outBit : Fin n → Fin (I + C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack I C ∧
    (∀ table : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool,
      let inputs := (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => List.ofFn (fun pat : Fin (2 ^ (w + 1)) =>
        table i (fun j => pat.val.testBit j.val)))).flatten
      let sols := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ n))).filter (fun z => ∀ i : Fin n,
        table i (fun j => z.val.testBit (n - 1 - ((i.val + j.val) % n))) = true)
      q.val < sols.card → ∃ z ∈ sols,
        (sols.filter (fun y => y.val < z.val)).card = q.val ∧
        ∀ pos : Fin n, (C.wires inputs).getD (outBit pos).val false =
          z.val.testBit (n - 1 - pos.val)) ∧
    ∃ k b : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ k ≤ w + 1 ∧ k + b ≤ n ∧ q.val < 2 ^ (k + b) ∧
      2 ^ PEqualNP.NotBracket.notCount C <

changed.title: Minimum numbers of raw sites and read wires for uniformly distributed binary reports
changed.statement:
let Word := fun k : Nat => Fin k → ZMod 2
let localRule := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (T : Fin n → Word n → ZMod 2) =>
  ∀ i x y, (∀ j ∈ D i, x j = y j) → T i x = T i y
let observed := fun (n m : Nat) (Q : Fin n → Word m) (U : Finset (Fin n))
    (T : Fin n → Word n → ZMod 2) (b : Word n) (z : U → ZMod 2) (r : Fin m) =>
  let x := fun i : Fin n => if h : i ∈ U then z ⟨i,h⟩ else b i
  ∑ i, (x i + T i x) * Q i r
let uniform := fun (n m : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (Q : Fin n → Word m)
    (U : Finset (Fin n)) =>
  ∀ T, localRule n D T → ∀ b v,
    2^m * Nat.card {z : U → ZMod 2 // observed n m Q U T b z = v} = 2^U.card
let readers := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin n) =>
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => j ∈ D i)).card
let wires := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) => ∑ i, (D i).card
∀ m : Nat, 1 ≤ m →
  let N := 2^m - 1
  (∃ (D : Fin N → Finset (Fin N)) (Q : Fin N → Word m),
    (∀ i, i ∉ D i) ∧
    (∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun r => Q i r ≠ 0)).card ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ j, readers N D j = m-1) ∧ wires N D = N*(m-1) ∧
    (∀ U, uniform N m D Q U ↔ U = Finset.univ)) ∧
  (∀ (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (Q : Fin n → Word m) (W : Finset (Fin n)),
    W.card = N → uniform n m D Q Finset.univ →
    (∀ j ∈ W, ¬ uniform n m D Q (Finset.univ.erase j)) →
    N ≤ n ∧ (∀ j ∈ W, m-1 ≤ readers n D j) ∧ N*(m-1) ≤ wires n D)

changed.title: Fibonacci numbers and one signed recurrence price consecutive mixed-site questions throughout the singular column bank
changed.statement:
∀ (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (h : ℕ), 3 ≤ h → h+2 ≤ 3*t →
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  let ix := fun j : ℕ => (⟨j % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.zero_lt_succ 5) ht)⟩ : Fin n)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (w : W) (i : Fin n) => w (ix (i.val + n - s % n))
  let out := fun (name c raw : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 raw + name
    let y := fun j : Fin n => old j + old (ix (j.val+2)) + old (ix (j.val+n-2))
    y i + (1+y (ix (i.val+1)))*y (ix (i.val+2)) + rot 4 raw i + c i
  let run := fun (ask : Fin h → ℕ → W →ₗ[F] F) (w : W) =>
    (List.finRange h).foldl (fun z i => 2*z + (if ask i z w = 0 then 0 else 1)) (0 : ℕ)
  let mix := fun (w : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 w
    old i + old (ix (i.val+2)) + old (ix (i.val+n-2))
  let m := 3*t-h
  let lo : ℤ := if m % 3 = 0 then 6 else if m % 3 = 1 then 11 else 19
  let hi : ℤ := if m % 3 = 0 then 34 else if m % 3 = 1 then 63 else 111
  let correction := (((!![0,1;-1,6] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ)^(m/3)).mulVec ![lo,hi]) 0
  ∀ (name c : W) (fixed : Bool) (k : ℕ), (fixed = true ∨ 100*(h+4)^2 ≤ t) →
    ((∃ (ask : Fin h → ℕ → W →ₗ[F] F) (A : ℕ → W →ₗ[F] W) (b : ℕ → W),
      (fixed = true → ∀ j p w, ask j p w = mix w (ix (2*j.val))) ∧
      k ≤ Nat.card {w : W // out name c w = A (run ask w) w + b (run ask w)}) ↔
      (k : ℤ) ≤ 2^(2*h-1)*((Nat.fib (2*m+3) : ℤ)+correction))

changed.title: Largest anchored one-hot rank with a nonlinear fan-in-two budget for each of two successive layers
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depths := fun (width : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate width 0)
let F := ZMod 2
∀ s k : ℕ,
  let pairs := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin s × Fin s)).filter (fun ij =>
    ij.1 < ij.2 ∧ ij.1.val % (2*k+1) ≠ ij.2.val % (2*k+1))).card
  let bound := if k = 0 then 2*s else 2*k+4*s+4*pairs
  let fit := fun (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) =>
    ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (cut : ℕ), cut ≤ C.gates.length ∧
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n+m) C ∧
      (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
      (C.gates.take cut).countP nonlinear ≤ s ∧ (C.gates.drop cut).countP nonlinear ≤ k ∧
      (∀ d ∈ depths (n+m) ⟨C.gates.take cut,0⟩, d ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ d ∈ depths (n+m+cut) ⟨C.gates.drop cut,0⟩, d ≤ 1) ∧
      PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  let rk := fun {n m : ℕ} (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m) =>
    let bit := fun i j => if G i j then (1 : F) else 0
    let X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) F := fun i j => bit i j + bit i v + bit u j + bit u v
    X.rank
  IsGreatest {r : ℕ | ∃ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool)
    (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m), fit n m G ∧ rk G u v = r} bound

An alternating nonsingular Gram matrix of size 2k gives 2k pairwise nonorthogonal vectors; adjoining their sum gives one more. Repeat them evenly and use full cube labels to attain the rank. changed.title: Perfect matchings count affine predictors one row below the saturated binary product budget
changed.statement:
∀ (n e : Nat), 0 < e →
  let m := 4*e-1
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin n → F
  let I := Fin m
  ∀ a b : I → W, (∀ i, a i ≠ 0 ∧ b i ≠ 0 ∧ a i ≠ b i) →
    let freq := fun i : I => ({a i, b i, a i+b i} : Finset W)
    let fs := (Finset.univ : Finset I).biUnion freq
    let odd := fs.filter (fun v => ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i => v ∈ freq i)).card % 2 = 1)
    let S := insert (0 : W) odd
    let outside := fun (i : I) => if h : ∃ v ∈ odd, v ∉ freq i then Classical.choose h else (0 : W)
    let good := (Finset.univ : Finset ((I → W) × (I → F))).filter (fun p =>
      ∀ x : W, ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i =>
        dotProduct (a i) x * dotProduct (b i) x ≠ dotProduct (p.1 i) x+p.2 i)).card ≤ e)
    let tally := fun (pivot : Option I) =>
      let nports := fun i : I => if pivot = some i then 4 else 3
      let label := fun (i : I) (j : Nat) =>
        if pivot = some i then outside i + (if j = 0 then 0 else if j = 1 then a i else if j = 2 then b i else a i+b i)
        else if j = 0 then a i else if j = 1 then b i else a i+b i
      let ports := (Finset.univ : Finset I).biUnion (fun i => (Finset.range (nports i)).image (fun j => (i,j)))
      let labels := ports.image (fun p => label p.1 p.2)
      let quota := fun v : W => (((ports.filter (fun p => label p.1 p.2 = v)).card) + (if pivot = none then 1 else 0)) / 2
      let V := (I × Nat) ⊕ (W × Nat)
      let localNodes := ports ∪ (Finset.univ : Finset I).image (fun i => (i,4))
      let slots := labels.biUnion (fun v => (Finset.range (quota v)).image (fun j => (v,j)))
      let verts : Finset V := localNodes.image Sum.inl ∪ slots.image Sum.inr
      let sameRow := fun (p q : I × Nat) => p.1 = q.1 ∧ p.2 ≠ q.2 ∧
        (p.2 = 4 ∨ q.2 = 4 ∨ p.2 / 2 = q.2 / 2)
      let attach := fun (p : I × Nat) (q : W × Nat) => p.2 < nports p.1 ∧ label p.1 p.2 = q.1
      let edge := fun (p q : V) => Sum.elim (fun x => Sum.elim (sameRow x) (attach x) q)
        (fun y => Sum.elim (fun x => attach x y) (fun _ => False) q) p
      let matchings := (Finset.univ : Finset (↥verts → ↥verts)).filter (fun f =>
        @decide (∀ x, f (f x) = x ∧ edge x.val (f x).val) (Classical.propDecidable _) = true)
      matchings.card / (∏ v ∈ labels, Nat.factorial (quota v))
    good.card = if 4 ≤ S.card ∧ (∀ v ∈ S, ∀ w ∈ S, v+w ∈ S) then
      S.card * tally none + (if S.card = 8 then ∑ i : I, if freq i ⊆ odd then tally (some i) else 0 else 0)
      else 0
